{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify QA orders: revenue = '999,999.99'
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999,999.99']

# Remove QA orders from the dataset
df_clean = df[~df.index.isin(qa_orders.index)]

# Count completed orders in clean data
completed_count_clean = (df_clean['status'] == 'completed').sum()

# Print result
completed_count_clean"}
